programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    anchors = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    if len(anchors) < 2:
        return out

    def nearby_count(anchor):
        r, c = anchor
        return sum(
            1 for i in range(h) for j in range(w)
            if grid[i][j] != 0 and (i, j) != anchor
            and max(abs(i-r), abs(j-c)) <= 4
        )

    source = max(anchors, key=nearby_count)
    sr, sc = source
    offsets = [(r-sr, c-sc, grid[r][c])
               for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    for tr, tc in anchors:
        if (tr, tc) == source:
            continue
        for dr, dc, color in offsets:
            r, c = tr + dr, tc + dc
            if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
file = programs / 'task-413ac87b.py'
file.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(file), 'exec'), globals())
